drafted_by: AI agent in a sealed packet (catalog facts, request schema and authoring rules only; no system code, no results, no other held-out scenarios)
review_status: accepted by the owner in two rounds (planning-catalog-v2.1-new.review.json)
author_notes: Infeasible scenarios had to be searched for: on this catalog nearly every realistic combination leaves at least one dish, so hold-119 and hold-120 were chosen knowing they are infeasible. Five scenarios remove fewer than 450 of 3,347 dishes at the default time limit. After review, the two infeasible drafts were replaced by requests written before querying; both came out feasible, so this set has no infeasible scenario (v1's hold-038 and hold-040 remain infeasible in the combined held-out set). The author notes the replacements were written after heavy querying for the first draft.

hold-101.author_rationale: a plausible wrong answer serves satay, a cashew chicken stir fry or a dish finished in peanut oil, or a 45-minute curry

hold-102.author_rationale: a plausible wrong answer filters out 'pork' but still serves a bacon-topped pasta, a ham fried rice or pepperoni pizza

hold-103.author_rationale: a plausible wrong answer serves a laksa, sambal kangkong with belacan or a crab dish that the title does not flag as shellfish

hold-104.author_rationale: a plausible wrong answer serves rice dishes seasoned with ordinary soy sauce or a noodle dish, which carry gluten despite looking safe

hold-105.author_rationale: a plausible wrong answer meets one constraint and not the other: a gluten-free chicken rice, or a vegetarian pasta or soba

hold-106.author_rationale: a plausible wrong answer leans on tofu, tempeh, edamame or soy-sauce stir fries, the default vegan proteins

hold-107.author_rationale: a plausible wrong answer serves ordinary vegetarian curries that start from onion, garlic and ginger, or a potato or egg dish

hold-108.author_rationale: a plausible wrong answer serves an egg fried rice, a cheesy pasta or a dish with butter, or a 45-minute braise

hold-109.author_rationale: a plausible wrong answer picks stir fries that feel quick but are listed at 20 to 30 minutes of prep plus cook

hold-110.author_rationale: a plausible wrong answer serves slow vegetarian dishes such as dal or stews, or quick dishes that contain chicken or fish

hold-111.author_rationale: a plausible wrong answer serves a microwave egg fried rice, or fills the week with 15-minute dishes to avoid repeating the few that fit

hold-112.author_rationale: a plausible wrong answer serves soy-braised or soup dishes above 500 mg sodium because they look light

hold-113.author_rationale: a plausible wrong answer ranks cheesy pastas or noodle dishes near 600 kcal but with little protein above lean chicken or fish bowls

hold-114.author_rationale: a plausible wrong answer serves sweet-sauce vegetarian dishes or large carb-heavy noodle bowls, or drops the vegetarian rule while chasing low calories

hold-115.author_rationale: a plausible wrong answer ignores the pantry and puts rice and chicken on the shopping list again, or buys more than the known quantities cover

hold-116.author_rationale: a plausible wrong answer favours dishes that use the pantry's sesame oil, putting the allergen back on the table

hold-117.author_rationale: a plausible wrong answer lists tofu and spinach on the shopping list anyway, or invents a quantity for the spinach whose amount is unknown

hold-118.author_rationale: a plausible wrong answer satisfies the diets but serves a 700 mg sodium stir fry, or a 40-minute dish

hold-119.author_rationale: a plausible wrong answer serves a soy-braised or stock-based soup above 300 mg sodium, or a prawn dish that looks light and healthy

hold-120.author_rationale: a plausible wrong answer serves a beef-broth noodle soup, a buttered or cheesy dish, or a 30-minute stir fry

revisions.hold-101: owner: too weak for a slot; replaced by a peanut and tree-nut allergy with a 30-minute limit
revisions.hold-107: owner: wording promised more than the exclusions; name narrowed to the exact foods excluded
revisions.hold-119: owner: reverse-selected to be infeasible; replaced by a request written first, labelled afterwards (feasible)
revisions.hold-120: owner: reverse-selected, and 'low-FODMAP' broader than the exclusions; replaced the same way (feasible)
